prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One fully NEW and reimagined StarNet game prop. Reference 1 is approved crate: exact finish/readability standard. Reference 2 is approved workstation: exact camera and craft. Reference 3 is approved bridge: world context. Use these solely as style references. Do not copy the crate or desk silhouette. South-facing overhead oblique station camera, perfectly straight-on in horizontal alignment, NO yaw, no isometric diagonals: horizontal long edges, vertical supports, symmetrical foreshortening, top planes visible at the same angle as workstation reference. Worn cool charcoal steel, broad readable panels, deep recesses, sparse purposeful brass/amber edge wear. Retain clear major parts at tiny game scale; no overly intricate micro-machinery, no arbitrary blue paint or bright chrome. Entire single prop isolated with generous margin and true transparent alpha background. No checkerboard, floor, room, text, other props, label or framing. Design a low wide equipment drawer bank from first principles. Three tiles wide one deep, its height BELOW the workstation knee line. Total silhouette width:height about 2.4:1. New construction: continuous shallow worktop with clipped front corners, two generously proportioned offset drawers on the left two-thirds, one recessed removable upright equipment case on the right third, solid horizontal toe plinth and two end bumpers. Recessed grab handles, broad flat steel surfaces, one small brushed metal latch tab per drawer. A functional coherent industrial storage cabinet, not a crate with lines drawn on it, not a pile of suitcases. Absolutely no screens or lights. High-quality believable material detail, crisp edges, little restrained wear.
